items.desc: The familiar lineup of seven club owners and former NSL executives returns with a brand-new tournament structure, with its first season kicking off on February 13.

items.title: 16 Musahar families get land titles after years of waiting
items.desc: The families in Rupandehi’s Gaidahawa Rural Municipality received legal ownership of the land they live on. The district has 82,000 registered landless people and informal settlers.

items.title: Bhotekoshi flood displaced 777 students. Nepal plans five-year school recovery
items.desc: Of the 57 educational institutions assessed in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, and Dhading districts, 28 were damaged and 15 were completely destroyed.

items.title: Loss and Damage Fund calls extraordinary meeting for Oct 22 to support Nepal
items.desc: Nepal formally requested an urgent response from the Fund on August 31, calling on the Board to take a special decision to provide assistance rapidly, directly and effectively.

items.title: Buying online? Ask for a tax bill, pay after delivery
items.desc: Police recovered money for only 10 percent of online fraud victims who filed complaints. Thousands of sellers operate online, but just 384 e-commerce businesses have registered with the government.

items.title: Beijing’s security concerns cloud Nepal’s push to reopen Tatopani
items.desc: Flood damage to Rasuwagadhi and the high cost of Korala leave the Sindhupalchok crossing vital to Nepal’s trade with China, but Beijing remains reluctant to reopen it over concerns about Tibet.

items.title: Over 1,500 flood-hit children suffer acute malnutrition
items.desc: Thirteen children have severe acute malnutrition, while experts warn that delayed intervention could push more children into life-threatening conditions.

items.title: Flash Protests Keep the Flag Flying; Dipke-Bora's Detentions, Police Action Fail to Deter Delhi's Protesters
items.desc: Delhi Police and security personnel were seen verbally and physically assaulting protesters carrying the national flag, as they forcibly dragged them into detention buses after dark.

items.title: Thai embassy defends visa process amid NATTA threat to halt tour sales
items.desc: The embassy blames visa delays on fraudulent or incomplete documents and last-minute applications, urging travellers to apply at least a month before departure.

items.title: Sudhakar Dalela appointed India’s next ambassador to Nepal
items.desc: The 1993-batch diplomat, who previously served as India’s ambassador to Bhutan and handled Nepal-Bhutan affairs at the foreign ministry, is expected to take up his new assignment shortly.

items.title: Indian police detain ‘cockroach’ movement founder Dipke ahead of protest

items.desc: The International Cricket Council sanctions the third edition of the tournament, which is scheduled to run from October 26 to November 21.

items.title: Nepal to Host ICC Asia Conference in November
items.desc: High-ranking international cricket delegates and representatives from Test and Associate nations will gather in Kathmandu, with visitors slated to watch the NPL playoffs.

items.title: How Rabindra Shakya is keeping the art of repoussé alive
items.desc: Shakya has spent more than 35 years practising repoussé, a centuries-old craft that can take nearly two years to complete a single large piece.

items.title: UML pulls out of Madhesh provincial government
items.desc: The party withdrew its support, accusing the Nepali Congress-led coalition of failing to implement a 15-point agreement, leaving the government in a minority.

items.title: 30MW Khani Khola hydropower project begins test generation
items.desc: The project in Dolakha district is supplying electricity to the national grid during a 15-day testing period before commercial operations begin.

items.title: Government declares flood- and landslide-hit areas in three districts disaster zones
items.desc: The three-month designation covers six local units or parts of them in Gorkha, Dhading and Baglung, with affected families eligible for monthly housing and livelihood assistance of at least Rs15,000.

items.title: Modi’s predicament: Gen Z pours out on India’s streets as dissent surges
items.desc: Youth-led protests over alleged voter-roll manipulation have tapped into wider anger over unemployment, exam leaks and divisive politics, posing the biggest challenge to Modi since he came to power in 2014.

items.title: Dashain shopping picks up, but livestock sales lag in Chitwan
items.desc: Traders who brought goats and Himalayan goats from western Nepal had hoped for brisk business, but buyers have been slower to arrive than expected.

items.desc: Counting for all 229 positions in the Nepali Congress’s 15th general convention ended on Friday morning, taking a week compared with 12 days at the previous convention.

items.desc: This visit comes as US oligarch Elon Musk described Mukesh Ambani as the “real boss of India” last week.

items.title: Nepal should be a ‘strategic broker’, not a buffer, says Amitabh Mattoo
items.desc: The JNU professor says diplomacy, stronger institutions and regional engagement can help Nepal play a greater role as Asia’s power balance shifts.

items.desc: The procession, rooted in Newa beliefs and traditions, has evolved in ways that threaten to overshadow its original significance.
